research_question: Do source-default Turtle Soup false-breakout filters on completed M5 XAUUSD bars isolate sufficiently strong post-reclaim reversals to survive frozen P75 execution over 30 seconds?
source_basis: MetaQuotes MQL5 Part 50 defines Turtle Soup as fading failed breaks of N-bar highs/lows after a meaningful sweep and confirmed close back inside.
Source defaults: lookback 20 bars, minimum extreme age 4 bars, sweep window 1 bar, confirmation closes 1, reversal body required, depth filter enabled, minimum 30 points and 2% of lookback range.
The detector works once per new bar on closed-bar information.

frozen_signal.sell: completed bar high above prior 20-bar reference high, close below reference, bearish body, reference high age >=4, sweep depth >=30 native raw and >=2% of lookback range
frozen_signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after completed sweep-bar right edge

failure_rule: If the source-default M5 profile fails supply/day or direct-net gate, retire TSO rather than tune defaults on Stage-A.
advance_rule: If it passes, freeze unchanged for independent later-January validation.
